ada-basal.qualifiers: Individualize, especially type1;25% reduction specifically discussed for evening before.

ada-nph.qualifiers: Not a product-specific renal or bowel-prep schedule.

cpoc-basal-am.qualifiers: Previous day unchanged; glucose on admission. Evening-only regimen differs.

cpoc-basal-pm.qualifiers: Twice-daily previous morning unchanged; procedure morning80%, evening unchanged. Once-evening procedure-day dose unchanged.

cpoc-prandial.qualifiers: Meal dose only, not basal or prescribed correction. Resume meal-linked doses with intake.

cpoc-premix.qualifiers: Day-before usual; lunchtime omitted if applicable; evening intake determines dose. No physical separation of components.

colon-first-before.qualifiers: Not routine fasting EGD; no unscheduled dose.

colon-first-am.qualifiers: Only if dose normally due before procedure.

colon-second-t1.qualifiers: Range, not an automatically selected number; never omit all basal.

colon-prandial.scope: Fixed prandial dose during carbohydrate-containing clear fluids
colon-prandial.qualifiers: Carbohydrate-ratio regimen uses usual ratio for actual carbohydrate. Clear fluid is not NPO.

colon-premix.qualifiers: Not morning-of procedure advice; additional TID dose requires individual plan.

colon-pump.qualifiers: Not U200/U500 or injection conversion. Device/cautery policy; avoid insulin-free gaps. Source advises no pump removal beyond1h.

asge-ufh-iv.qualifiers: Table2 duration, NOT an exact last-dose order.

asge-ufh-sc.qualifiers: Do not assign LMWH24h or IV4h to SC prophylaxis/therapy.

asge-ufh-resume.qualifiers: Historical MAY restart when bleeding stable, not unconditional high-risk restart.

chest-ufh-resume.qualifiers: Recommendation17 >=24h after; adequate hemostasis, avoid bolus/consider lower intensity. Distinct from older ASGE early option.

asge-dipy.qualifiers: Whole-combination timing NOT_ADDRESSED. Aspirin7-10day pharmacology is not a hold order.

ukcpa-combo.scope: Usual elective surgery including fixed combination
ukcpa-combo.qualifiers: Usually continue. Exceptional bleeding consequence may prompt stopping day before. Postop resume usual dosage unless hematology advises otherwise; no exact hour. General surgical comparator, not universal GI protocol.

insulin.indications: Type1, type2 and other insulin-deficient states differ. Adult elective EGD fasting versus colonoscopy/combined bowel prep. Urgent, pediatric, pregnancy and critical illness need separate pathways.
insulin.renal: No reviewed source supplies a universal drug-specific CrCl/eGFR cutoff-to-dose table for these insulins. CKD/AKI and intake require individual assessment, not DOAC renal strata.
insulin.hepatic: Hepatic failure/malnutrition and poor intake require individual assessment; no Child-Pugh-to-percentage schedule is asserted.

AOA26.ketones: Unwell or two consecutive glucose values >13mmol/L

insulin.anesthesia: Sedation may mask hypoglycemia. Coordinate glucose checks, rescue treatment and insulin continuity; prolonged fasting, IV infusion and pump removal need a dedicated plan.
insulin.resumption: Next usual scheduled regimen after regular meals/hydration recover, adjusted for glucose/intake; no catch-up dose. Pump/IV transitions must maintain basal coverage.
resumptionSources: CPOC23 eating/drinking and IV transition sections
insulin.societyDisagreement: CPOC morning basal80% differs colonoscopy-review50%; ADA75-80% basal is perioperative, not universal bowel-prep advice. NPH50% ADA differs CPOC80% basal table. Preserve separate source choices.
insulin.sourceLimitations: AOA26 main text verified, AppendixS3 inaccessible. COLON22 is an author review, not formal CAG guidance. U500, pump/IV and complex regimens explicitly individualized.
insulin.timingNotHolding: Meal/basal adjustment is not a stop-all-insulin instruction; type1 basal must not be omitted.

procedures.ASGE16: Diagnostic EGD/colonoscopy including biopsy low; polypectomy higher
procedures.IDEN24: Cold snare polyp<=1cm low; larger EMR/ESD/papillectomy may be ultra-high

antithrombotic.renal: No reviewed guideline supplies a UFH or aspirin/ER-dipyridamole renal cutoff-to-hold table. Renal dysfunction changes assessment; do not borrow DOAC/LMWH thresholds.
antithrombotic.hepatic: Coagulopathy, thrombocytopenia and active bleeding require individual assessment; no invented hepatic hold schedule.
antithrombotic.anesthesia: Routine endoscopic sedation is not neuraxial anesthesia. Neuraxial placement/removal needs its own protocol; do not extrapolate these intervals.
antithrombotic.bridgeDecision: Do not create a bridge indication from a stop/restart interval. BSG/IDEN favor selected high-risk VKA bridging; ACG/CAG against routine bridging with mechanical-valve exception; CHEST generally against bridging (AF strong, others conditional) with selected high-risk implementation exceptions; AHA24 permits selected high-risk VKA bridging and discourages routine bridging.
antithrombotic.indications: UFH therapeutic bridging, prophylaxis, other inpatient and catheter/dialysis uses are distinct. Fixed aspirin/dipyridamole is secondary stroke prevention, not P2Y12-based coronary DAPT.
